hero.title: Build a store your customers will love
hero.subtitle: Lumora gives you everything you need to sell online — beautiful themes, secure payments and smart marketing tools in one place.

logos.title: Powering fast-growing brands around the world

features.title: Everything you need to sell online
features.subtitle: From your first product to your millionth order, Lumora grows with you.
features.f1_text: Create a stunning storefront in minutes without writing a single line of code.
features.f2_text: Accept cards, wallets and local payment methods with built-in fraud protection.
features.f3_text: Track stock across warehouses and get alerts before you run out.
features.f4_text: Send abandoned cart emails, discounts and newsletters automatically.
features.f5_text: See what sells, where visitors come from and how your store is growing.
features.f6_text: Sell in multiple currencies and languages with automatic tax calculation.

steps.title: Launch your store in three simple steps
steps.s2_text: Upload photos, set prices and write descriptions.
steps.s3_text: Connect your domain and open your doors to the world.

pricing.title: Simple pricing for every stage
pricing.subtitle: Start with a 14-day free trial. Upgrade or downgrade at any time.
pricing.starter_desc: For new businesses getting their first sales.
pricing.growth_desc: For growing brands that need more power.
pricing.enterprise_desc: For large teams with advanced needs.

testimonials.title: Loved by store owners everywhere
testimonials.t1_quote: We moved our store to Lumora in a weekend and our sales went up by 40% in the first month.
testimonials.t2_quote: The checkout is so fast that our customers keep telling us how easy it is to buy.
testimonials.t3_quote: Support answers in minutes, not days. It feels like having an extra team member.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need technical skills to use Lumora?
faq.a1: No. Everything works with drag and drop, and our guides walk you through each step.
faq.q2: Can I use my own domain name?
faq.a2: Yes. You can connect a domain you already own or buy a new one inside Lumora.
faq.q3: What happens when my free trial ends?
faq.a3: You can choose a plan to keep your store online. Your data stays safe for 30 days.
faq.q4: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a4: Yes. There are no contracts and no cancellation fees.
